Description: This level is designed to help learners develop a strong understanding of fundamental concepts while gradually improving their knowledge and practical skills. It includes structured lessons, interactive activities, examples, and practice exercises that encourage learners to participate actively in the learning process. Students will explore important topics, understand key principles, and apply their knowledge to simple real-world situations. The level also focuses on improving problem-solving, logical thinking, communication, and independent learning abilities. By completing this level, learners should be able to understand essential concepts, demonstrate their knowledge confidently, complete assigned activities, and prepare themselves for more advanced topics and future learning opportunities.
